sections.heading: Swaps for main and b3-tokens
sections.note: main with all three: average MV 2.81 → 2.82, MV ≤ 2 33 → 33, MV ≤ 3 49 → 50. b3-tokens with both: 2.73 → 2.73, 34 → 33, 51 → 51. b4 gets no swap.

why: It's a {2} flash artifact that phases her out with her Equipment and counters, which covers edicts, exile wraths and bounce.
Growth and voltron go from 5 to 4 and protection from 8 to 9, both onto target. main is the last list still running Blackblade.
flags: Cast it on opponents' turns. On your own turn she'd be gone for the rest of the turn.

why: It draws two, and any reducer plus her refund makes it free. Draw goes from 7 to 8.
Forge gives one counter the turn she lands, and every other list has cut it already.
flags: Lands go from 32 to 31, which is what b3-tokens runs. Red sources stay at 26.

why: It's Thermo-Alchemist's ping, but any noncreature spell untaps it: 50 of the list's nonland cards instead of 28.
flags: It costs one more mana and swaps a 0/3 defender for a 3/2.

why: Each 1/1 token becomes two cards for {1}, and draw goes from 6 to 7. Nothing in the list pumps toughness, so nothing switches it off.
Kediss only works in combat while two or more opponents are alive, and this list's plan ends with a swing at the last opponent.
Both trigger on noncreature spells. Kessig deals 1 to each opponent, while Instructor makes a 1/1 Officer.
Impact Tremors, Purphoros, Goblin Bombardment and Skullclamp each turn that Officer into more than 1 damage, and alone it's still a blocker.

pairs.note: Bench, not swap, because cantrips are protected.
